entities.summary: Bechara Boutros Al-Ra'i is the 77th Maronite Patriarch of Antioch, and head of the Maronite Church, a position he has held since 15 March 2011, succeeding Patriarch Nasrallah Boutros Sfeir. Rahi was made a cardinal on 24 November 2012 by Pope Benedict XVI. He is a member of the Mariamite Maronite Order. Bechara Boutros al-Rahi was a religious figures from Himlaya (b. 1940-02-25, Himlaya). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
